limitations: Selected modules and bounded fixtures only; no complete app build, Android-device execution or performance claim.
Resolved app inputs remain partial when generated/KSP/R outputs are missing; these setup failures remain explicit.
Corpus reports are single-file first-blocker probes. Missing dependencies do not establish intrinsic invalidity; emission does not establish runtime/ABI/metadata compatibility.

ReadingGuide remains a separately reported unsupported stretch target; value classes, coroutines, Compose/general serialization transforms and KSP generation remain deferred. The preexisting bounded empty Serializable singleton path is preserved.

Escaped classifier names with literal dollar characters, generic aliases, enum-entry bodies and DoubleArray retain explicit recorded boundaries; function-type alias parameter labels are not byte-exact metadata claims.
Ordinary class/member adjacent double-semicolon grammar remains a preexisting non-target limitation. Automatic Kotlin main(String[]) launcher lowering is unassessed.
Five preexisting Kotlin documentation image Git LFS pointers remain setup exceptions; application, specification and compiler source hashes were verified.
The allocating-inline historical row uses matching explicitly recorded controlled HotSpot hash options; generated inline-owner class regeneration remains unsupported.
next_milestone: Plan value-class JVM representation using unchanged Gid/Rpp as targets, including boxed/nullable/generic and Java/Kotlin consumer contracts; do not implement it in this delivery.

validation_freezes.scope: After the language freeze, only friend-input model capture/replay and their Python tests changed in v5; v6 additionally refreshes the baseline regression runner and audits all seven preserved original interop rows, adding focused positive proofs only where supported and retaining strict unsupported rejection elsewhere. All Rust/Cargo sources and existing source fixtures are identical. The shared classpath-unpacking function is AST-identical. Feature checks retain v4; model/module/corpus checks retain v5; affected baseline and Python checks use v6. The required source aggregate transparently combines the new baseline with the five unchanged v4 suites, recording each original run origin. All use the same final compiler binary.
